evaluation.completion: Original HOLD + speed <= .005 for 40 frames AND final Euclidean error <= .12 m
evaluation.horizon: Use saved trajectory at 150 s for unended runs; completion time only for tasks already terminated successfully
evaluation.censoring: Unfinished at 600 s is right-censored; early off-target HOLD is separately reported
evaluation.safety: Original separation, clearance, penetration and QP failure checks; scaling events separately reported
evaluation.comparisons: Four methods paired within nine reused development conditions; previous vector-CVT isolates readout change. Every failure/error retained.
evaluation.gate: Primary mechanistic outcome: C-away reaches and settles under the original completion criterion with no hard safety violation. Broader development support requires a net completion gain vs both original controls, at most one lost completion and no new hard safety failure. No default promotion or reliability claim on this reused seed.
evaluation.error_policy: Every planned/launched case remains in denominator; errors, timeouts, regressions and budget cutoffs retained

information.local: Fixed reference from own/one-hop boundary returns, bootstrapped at CONTACT_READY from the existing displacement estimate. Metric SE(2) readout thereafter; no physical pose/contact truth.
information.shared: Existing all-team vector median drives the existing common phase supervisor; not fully decentralized.
information.safety: Original map, object velocity, QP, contact physics, thresholds and independent stopping/completion unchanged.
information.abstention: Initialization has no measured velocity vote; failed/missing reference matches do not send a fresh navigation vote.
information.limitations: Persistent observed centroid is not known center of mass; bootstrap bias remains; no absolute-error certificate.

candidate: Replace vector-CVT displacement/transport-velocity messages only. Same deployment, compressive control, common phase gates, 0.02m estimated arrival tube; no truth-based HOLD.
